text: In November 2019, the Bloorcourt Village Early Learning Centre, located at 823 Dovercourt Road, contacted my office to report that the current pick-up/drop off zone, which operates from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 4:00 to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, in front of the centre can no longer accommodate their needs. According to the Centre, parents often park in the adjacent 'no standing' zones when they pick-up/drop-off their children. As a result, parents are often ticketed. The purpose of this motion is to extend the period of the pick-up/drop off zone from 7:00 a.m. 10:00 a.m.

City Council on December 17 and 18, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the existing maximum 15-minute parking regulation in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Dovercourt Road, between a point 87 metres north of Northumberland Street and a point 13 metres further north, to be in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. and from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday.
